traps.title: Route outbound calls through resilientClient
traps.context: When code performs an outbound call that may fail transiently.
traps.mistake: Calling a transport primitive directly skips the shared retry policy.
traps.fix: Use resilientClient so retry and backoff behavior stays centralized.

traps.title: Attach requestIdempotencyKey before retrying writes
traps.context: When a write request can be retried after a transient failure.
traps.mistake: Retrying a non-idempotent write can create duplicate records.
traps.fix: Generate requestIdempotencyKey once and reuse it for every attempt.

traps.title: Enforce httpResponseByteLimit before parsing
traps.context: When a response body comes from an untrusted endpoint.
traps.mistake: Parsing an unbounded body can exhaust process memory.
traps.fix: Reject bodies larger than httpResponseByteLimit before decoding them.

traps.title: Set requestDeadlineMs at the client boundary
traps.context: When an outbound request must not wait indefinitely.
traps.mistake: Scattered timers create inconsistent cancellation behavior.
traps.fix: Pass requestDeadlineMs through the shared client boundary.

traps.title: Resolve callers through principalProvider
traps.context: When application code needs the current caller.
traps.mistake: Reading transport headers directly duplicates trust decisions.
traps.fix: Ask principalProvider for the validated caller.

traps.title: Decode cookies with sessionCookieCodec
traps.context: When a session cookie enters the application boundary.
traps.mistake: Hand parsing bypasses signature and expiry validation.
traps.fix: Use sessionCookieCodec and reject invalid payloads.

traps.title: Validate destinations with loginRedirectGuard
traps.context: When login completion redirects to a caller-provided location.
traps.mistake: Trusting the destination enables an open redirect.
traps.fix: Require loginRedirectGuard to approve the destination.

traps.title: Increment authenticationEpoch after credential reset
traps.context: When a user resets a credential or revokes every active grant.
traps.mistake: Old grants remain valid when revocation state is unchanged.
traps.fix: Increment authenticationEpoch and reject grants from older epochs.

traps.title: Apply persistent shape changes through schemaPlan
traps.context: When stored record structure changes across releases.
traps.mistake: Changing only current queries leaves prior installations incompatible.
traps.fix: Add an idempotent step to schemaPlan and verify upgrade behavior.

traps.title: Wrap related writes in dbWriteTransaction
traps.context: When multiple database records represent one logical update.
traps.mistake: Independent writes can persist a partial state.
traps.fix: Run every related write inside dbWriteTransaction.

traps.title: Bind values through sqlParameterBinder
traps.context: When user-controlled values enter a database statement.

traps.title: Reject records from a newer schemaEpoch
traps.context: When opening persisted data written by another application version.
traps.mistake: Reading an unknown newer shape can silently discard fields.
traps.fix: Refuse schemaEpoch values newer than the reader supports.
